rate_medical_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
rate_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

flag_medical_exempt.long_name: Why rate_medical_exempt carries no value on this row
flag_medical_exempt.short_description: Whether rate_medical_exempt was published as a number, suppressed, not reported, or censored at a bound.
flag_medical_exempt.long_description: Per-measure companion to rate_medical_exempt. BLANK means the source printed a figure and nothing is censored -- only the exceptions carry text. "suppressed" means the source withheld the cell to protect a small count (an asterisk run: "*", "**", "***"). "missing" means it was not reported at all ("N/A", "--", "NR"). "top_coded" means the source printed an upper bound such as ">95%" instead of a figure, so the true value lies ABOVE the bound; the rate column holds the bound the source printed, not a substitute invented for it, so it must be read as interval-censored rather than as a measurement. "bottom_coded" is the same the other way ("<5"). "suppressed" and "missing" both leave the rate empty but are not the same thing: a suppressed cell has a real measurement behind it that the state chose not to print, whereas a missing one was never collected.

rate_mmr_1dose_24m.long_name: Proportion of residents aged 24 months with 1 dose(s) of MMR in the state immunization registry
rate_mmr_1dose_24m.short_description: Share of residents aged 24 months recorded in the state immunization registry as having 1 dose(s) of MMR.
rate_mmr_1dose_24m.long_description: Registry-based coverage: the share of children aged 24 months in the county with 1 MMR dose(s) recorded in the state immunization information system, by calendar year. Not a school-entry survey measure: the denominator is resident children in the registry, not enrolled students, and changes to registry exclusion rules move the series.
rate_mmr_1dose_24m.statement: In {location}, {value} of residents aged 24 months had 1 MMR dose(s) in the immunization registry.

rate_mmr_2dose_6y.long_name: Proportion of residents aged 6 with 2 dose(s) of MMR in the state immunization registry
rate_mmr_2dose_6y.short_description: Share of residents aged 6 recorded in the state immunization registry as having 2 dose(s) of MMR.
rate_mmr_2dose_6y.long_description: Registry-based coverage: the share of children aged 6 in the county with 2 MMR dose(s) recorded in the state immunization information system, by calendar year. Not a school-entry survey measure: the denominator is resident children in the registry, not enrolled students, and changes to registry exclusion rules move the series. Wyoming's report cards carry the same measure under an age label that changes between years (6 years of age on the 2018 cards, 7-years-old on the 2019 to 2021 cards); the column keeps one name so the series stays in one column.
rate_mmr_2dose_6y.statement: In {location}, {value} of residents aged 6 had 2 MMR dose(s) in the immunization registry.

rate_mmr_2dose_6_18y.long_description: Registry-based coverage: the share of children aged 6 to 18 in the county with 2 MMR dose(s) recorded in the state immunization information system, by calendar year. Not a school-entry survey measure: the denominator is resident children in the registry, not enrolled students, and changes to registry exclusion rules move the series.
rate_mmr_2dose_6_18y.statement: In {location}, {value} of residents aged 6 to 18 had 2 MMR dose(s) in the immunization registry.

wi_school_immunization.name: Wisconsin School Immunization Data
wi_school_immunization.description: Two DHS series in one file, told apart by the type column. SCHOOL ROWS (type = school) carry the waiver shares from the annual student immunization reports, one row per school and school year. DHS suppresses any share below 5 percent as "<5", which covers about 95 percent of cells, and publishes no enrolment, so these rows are NOT rolled up to county here: an unweighted mean over the few unsuppressed schools described one small school, not the county. COUNTY ROWS (type = county) are MMR coverage from the Wisconsin Immunization Registry (WIR), by calendar year, for three age groups: 1 dose at 24 months (rate_mmr_1dose_24m), 2 doses at age 6 (rate_mmr_2dose_6y) and 2 doses at ages 6 to 18 (rate_mmr_2dose_6_18y). These are registry measures of resident children, not the school survey, so they are named distinctly and must not be compared with survey MMR figures in other states. Calendar year N is dated to the school year ending in N. From 2023 DHS excludes long-inactive registry records from the denominator, which breaks the 6-18 series; the 2025 release also redefined the age bands and restated every year.
wi_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
